bias.en: Neutral · back above every average but the 100-day
bias.zh: 中性 · 重回除 100 日外所有均线上方

read.en: Rockwell Automation rose 2.5% on Oct 21 to $438.51, between $428.57 and $441.39. It is above the falling 5-day ($427.8), 10-day ($429.5) and 30-day ($430.6) averages and the rising 200-day ($426.2), but below the falling 100-day ($447.6). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13 and is below zero, with the histogram fading toward a cross; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($446.54), and RSI is 55.
read.zh: 罗克韦尔自动化 10月21日上涨 2.5%，收于 $438.51，盘中区间 $428.57–441.39。股价位于下行的 5 日（$427.8）、10 日（$429.5）和 30 日均线（$430.6）以及上行的 200 日均线（$426.2）上方，但低于下行的 100 日均线（$447.6）。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄、接近交叉；抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$446.54），RSI 为 55。

read.en: The close cleared $430 (10 and 30-day averages) and $436 (Sep 8, Oct 14 highs); both now become support. Resistance is $441.4 (day's high), then $446.5–447.6 (SAR, 100-day) and $460.2 (Oct 6 high). Support is $436, then $426–430.6 (5 to 200-day averages) and $412.7–413.9 (Oct 15, 20 lows). A close above $447.6 would open $460; a close below $426 would reopen $413.
